threads.procedure: organisations, languages and games series with two or more placed members (one thread each)

countries.procedure: distinct places (states, territories, one historic state) that at least one thread passes through

states.procedure: sovereign states (P31 Q3624078) among current Wikidata items with an ISO 3166 alpha-3 code (P298)

territories.procedure: current Wikidata items with an ISO alpha-3 code that are not sovereign states

repoOrgs.procedure: objects with a `members` field in data/*.json

proseMembers.procedure: of those, `members` given as prose rather than a list

filledFromWikidata.procedure: prose or one-member lists filled from Wikidata member-of (P463) by a matching name or short name

stillUnthreaded.procedure: organisations with fewer than two placed members after filling

unmappedNames.procedure: distinct member names that resolve to no country (territories, regions, prose)

maxThrough.procedure: the most threads through one country

heritageSites.procedure: distinct World Heritage Sites in Wikidata, by the leading number of the UNESCO id (P757); a site in several countries counts once

heritageByCountrySum.procedure: per-country counts summed: higher than the total because a site that crosses a border counts in each country

gamesHosts.procedure: host entries across the games series

repairedFiles.procedure: files that did not parse at dad93b5 and were repaired (the Data page lists each change)
